messages:
Ravi M: Heads-up - prepping QBR for Solstice Health. Need 90d token forecast + top spend risks. Clara, can you pull token mix? Nina, any onboarding issues that could affect renewals?
Clara H: Pulled 30d. ~850k tokens. Embeds 60%, chat 40%. Current est $17k/mo. If they flip on nightly bulk embeds, could hit $28k/mo. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/solstice
Nina S: Onboarding: retention webhooks still unverified, docs missing for bulk-embed streaming sample. Their GTM lead wants cost caps set before broader rollout.
Ravi M: Ok. Actions: 1) Clara - add conservative cap scenario ($25k) + cache mitigations to slides. 2) Nina - confirm webhook ETA and ask list for enablement. 3) BillingBot - create alert at $24k. Can we have 1+3 by EOD?
BillingBot: Alert created: Solstice Health monthly threshold set to $24,000. Notifying billing@solstice.com and #cs-solstice (id: ab-174660).
Clara H: Added slide with conservative/optimistic lines and cache TTL recommendation (reduce kv-ttl for interactive flows). ETA 1700.
Nina S: Webhook vendor scheduled Wed. Sending enablement invite now.
Ravi M: Thanks team - will include mitigation plan in the QBR.
